artDirection: Premium painted HD-2D fantasy tactical RPG departure at the canonical Lion field camp. This is the first forward-moving campaign beat after the chronicle, not a replay of the prologue. Preserve subdued dawn light, camp geography, Lion identity, and restrained resolve.

shots.purpose: Establish the company at the edge of the fallen camp preparing to leave.
shots.promptIntent: Alistair settles his stance toward the road while Seraphine acknowledges him with only a slight posture change. Camp banners and tent cloth move gently; do not replay battles, casualties, or prologue exposition.

shots.purpose: Show the company beginning the march and hand cleanly to existing dialogue and journey progression.
shots.promptIntent: Alistair takes two slow steps toward screen right and comes to a stable stop. Seraphine stays planted on the established right side, continuously looking screen-left at Alistair; lock her head, shoulders, torso, feet, and staff to that screen-left orientation for the entire shot. She must not turn toward screen-right or follow the camera. End with the road and camp exit readable.
